name: Aurora Wireless Headphones
description: Over-ear headphones with active noise cancellation and a 40-hour battery. Memory-foam cushions keep long listening sessions comfortable, and multipoint pairing lets you switch between laptop and phone without reconnecting.

name: Pulse Smartwatch
description: Track workouts, sleep and heart rate on a bright always-on AMOLED display. Water resistant to 5 ATM with a week of battery life on a single charge.

name: Strider Running Sneakers
description: Lightweight road runners with a responsive foam midsole and breathable engineered mesh upper. Designed for daily training on pavement and treadmill alike.

name: Nomad Everyday Backpack
description: A 24L backpack with a padded 16-inch laptop sleeve, water-resistant shell and hidden anti-theft pocket. Ventilated straps make commutes and carry-ons comfortable.

name: Solstice Polarized Sunglasses
description: Polarized lenses cut glare while UV400 protection shields your eyes. The feather-light frame floats on the face and stays put through the active part of your day.

name: Lumina Instant Camera
description: Point, shoot and print credit-card sized photos in under a minute. Built-in selfie mirror, flash control and 10 prints per pack make it the life of any party.

name: Breeze Organic Cotton Tee
description: A relaxed-fit tee in 100% organic cotton with a pre-washed, no-shrink finish. Versatile enough for the office-casual dress code or the weekend.

name: Mechkey Mechanical Keyboard
description: Hot-swappable switches, per-key RGB and a CNC aluminium frame. USB-C and Bluetooth wireless let you float between desk setups with a single cable.
